answer: Duplicate-cluster payout splitting pays a farm of lookalike seats as one author. After each epoch closes, passed answers are compared by 3-word shingles, and any group above 35% overlap is merged into one thread that earns a single reward, split equally among its members. Fifty seats that forge answers from one template each collect 2% of one payout. Light rewording keeps the shared sentence frame, which a second frame check also merges, so even at the zenith of an attack every extra seat must produce its own original reasoning, a full answer of real work per fake per epoch.
